# Message Keyword

A flag/keyword applied to a message (IMAP flag or JMAP keyword) such as seen, flagged, answered, draft, forwarded, or junk.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MessageKeyword>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:MessageKeyword`
